label: step-025
payload: Write a Python script called 'apply_renames.py' that reads 'renames.csv' and applies each old-to-new pair as a whole-word rename across 'core_alpha.py', 'core_beta.py', and 'core_gamma.py' — reading each file's text, substituting every pair, and writing it back — then run it with python3 using the Bash tool (not the context-mode MCP sandbox). The script must read the mapping from 'renames.csv' (not hardcode it). Important: perform the rename by writing and running that script — do NOT use your Edit/Write tools to change the three source files directly.
